source_review.notes: Checked all six references for identity, current-document status, and bounded support for nearby claims. Google's monitoring chapter supports symptom-versus-cause discipline, black-box and white-box distinctions, high-signal pager paths, and the four golden signals. Its alerting-on-SLOs chapter supports multiwindow burn-rate reasoning; effective troubleshooting supports triage and protecting the service before deep diagnosis; incident response supports early coordination. Current Prometheus documentation states that Alertmanager handles deduplication, grouping, routing, silencing, and inhibition and documents the group_wait delay/completeness trade-off plus missing-label inhibition semantics. All six canonical URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-06. Product behavior is explicitly scoped to retrieved current documentation rather than generalized to every version or alerting system.
